title: 🏗️ Combination of Solids — Building Complex Shapes
hook: A medicine capsule is a cylinder with two hemispherical ends. An ice cream cone is a cone topped with a hemisphere. A toy is a cone on top of a hemisphere. These 'combined solids' are everywhere!
explanation:
Volume of combined solid = Sum of volumes of each part.
⚠️ Tip: Surface area ≠ Sum of surface areas! You must subtract the areas that are hidden (joined surfaces).

Common combinations:

ShapeVolumeSurface Area
Cylinder + 2 hemispheres (capsule)πr²h + (4/3)πr³2πrh + 4πr² (no flat ends!)
Cone + hemisphere (ice cream)(1/3)πr²h + (2/3)πr³πrl + 2πr² (no base!)
Cylinder + cone on topπr²h + (1/3)πr²H2πrh + πrl + πr² (one base only)
💡 Tip: When two solids are joined, the touching surfaces are inside the combined shape and don't count toward the total surface area.
worked_example:
Example: A toy is shaped as a cone on top of a hemisphere. Cone: height = 4 cm, radius = 3 cm. Find total surface area.

1
Slant height of cone
l = √(r² + h²) = √(9 + 16) = 5 cm
2
CSA of cone
πrl = π(3)(5) = 15π cm²
3
CSA of hemisphere
2πr² = 2π(9) = 18π cm²
4
Total surface area
15π + 18π = 33π ≈ 103.67 cm² (no base circle counted!)

try_this.question: A medicine capsule is a cylinder (length 10 mm, radius 3.5 mm) with hemispherical ends. Find its total volume and surface area.
try_this.hint: Cylinder height = 10 mm (the straight part). Two hemispheres = one sphere.

fun_fact: A rocket is typically a combination of a cone (nose), cylinder (body), and possibly a frustum (engine section) — the exact shapes we study here!
